plan: Deep-copy the recipe at entry so adapt/print_original never mutate inputs; print_original returns authored_text verbatim.
Compute one Fraction scale factor (target_yield / recipe yield) and apply it to every ingredient quantity, including catalog-introduced additional ingredients.

Resolve each excluded ingredient through a substitution chain: select the catalog choice with the lowest (priority, catalog-index) key, apply name/quantity_factor/unit/preparation, wording_changes across all instruction lists, and equipment additions/removals.
Detect cycles with a per-chain visited-name set that is inherited by recursively resolved additional ingredients, so a later-reintroduced exclusion terminates as a cycle reason.

Accumulate reasons in a set and keep processing after any failure (and always run the final equipment-availability check) so every independently applicable reason is reported, sorted and deduplicated.
Handle optional components with a snapshot/rollback of reasons, choices, warnings, equipment, and instruction text: drop the component with a warning instead of failing the whole adaptation.

Assemble the adapted recipe with yield = target, sorted equipment validated as a subset of available_equipment, edited instruction strings, ordered choice IDs, and sorted warnings; on impossibility return recipe=None with sorted reasons.
mechanisms: per-chain visited-set cycle detection inherited by additional ingredients
in-place wording replacement across registered instruction lists
